raw_specs.value: Experience lightning-fast loading with an ultra-high speed SSD, deeper immersion with support for haptic feedback 1 , adaptive triggers 1 and 3D Audio 1 , and an incredible collection of PlayStation games.
"Enable Javascript on browser"
Explore spectacular new worlds in generation-defining games exclusive to PlayStation consoles.
Jump into the action and keep play moving with ultra-fast, integrated console technology.
Put yourself at the heart of the game with responsive controls, 360-degree audio 1 , and intricate graphical detail.
Immerse yourself in games that look and sound stunning, including console exclusives from PlayStation Studios and full backwards compatibility for your PS4 library.
Experience generation-defining games from PlayStation Studios.

raw_specs.section: Play the biggest games on PlayStation
raw_specs.raw_label: Play the biggest games on PlayStation
raw_specs.value: Join millions of players in legendary titles like Fortnite, Monster Hunter Wilds, and Grand Theft Auto V.
Play over 8,500 PS4 games 3 on PS5 consoles. Enjoy faster and smoother frame rates in select PS4 games with PS5’s Game Boost technology.
Join PlayStation Plus and enjoy instant access to a huge library of PS5 and PS4 games that evolves every month, with a choice of membership plans 2 to suit how you play.

raw_specs.section: Hundreds of games ready to play
raw_specs.raw_label: Hundreds of games ready to play
raw_specs.value: Choose your next adventure from a vast library of PS5 and PS4 titles including recent releases, innovative indies, big-budget hits, and Ubisoft+ Classics.
Step back in time to enjoy hundreds of much-loved games from the original PlayStation, PS2, and PS3 consoles, and PSP (PlayStation®Portable).
Expand your collection with monthly games delivered straight to your console, yours to play as long as you remain a member.
Harness the might of a custom CPU, GPU and SSD that deliver breathtaking graphics and smooth gameplay.
An ultra-high-speed SSD maximises your play sessions for installed PS5 games.
The custom integration of the PS5 console’s systems lets creators pull data from the SSD so quickly that they can design games in ways never before possible.

raw_specs.section: Explore lifelike environments with Ray Tracing
raw_specs.raw_label: Explore lifelike environments with Ray Tracing
raw_specs.value: Ray Tracing brings new levels of realism with natural shadows and reflections in supported PS5 games.
Intricate details come to life with your 4K TV and compatible PS5 games. With an HDR TV, supported PS5 games pop with an unbelievable range of colours.

raw_specs.section: Navigate game worlds with incredible responsiveness
raw_specs.raw_label: Navigate game worlds with incredible responsiveness
raw_specs.value: Smooth and fluid high-frame-rate gameplay for compatible games.

raw_specs.section: Immersive play with the DualSense® wireless controller
raw_specs.raw_label: Immersive play with the DualSense® wireless controller
raw_specs.value: Discover a deeper gaming experience* with the incredibly tactile features of the innovative PS5 controller.

raw_specs.section: Immersive play with the DualSense® wireless controller
raw_specs.raw_label: Immersive play with the DualSense® wireless controller
raw_specs.value: *Compared to DUALSHOCK®4 wireless controller

Dynamic resistance mimics the tension of interactions with in-game gear and objects in select PS5 games. From pulling back an increasingly tight bowstring to hitting the brakes on a speeding car, feel physically connected to your on-screen actions.

Responsive vibrations react to your in-game choices and simulate environmental factors in select PS5 games. In your hands, these dynamic vibrations can simulate the feeling of everything from environments to the recoil of different weapons.

From the distant calls of teammates to the nearby approach of sneaking predators, your surroundings come alive with Tempest 3D AudioTech through TV speakers or compatible headphones in supported games.
Build your ultimate PS5 setup with additional controllers and matching console covers, audio headsets and more.

Discover a range of vibrant DualSense wireless controller colours, raise your game with the ultra-customisable DualSense Edge™ wireless controller, explore a world of possibilities for players with diverse needs with the Access™ controller, and elevate your arcade or simulator game with wheels, fight sticks and other specialist controllers.

Studio-inspired planar magnetic drivers enable our new headset and earbuds to reproduce PS5 3D Audio 1 with astonishing accuracy. Pinpoint threats with razor-sharp precision and pick out subtle details, all delivered to you at lightning-fast speed using new PlayStation Link™ wireless technology.
Change up your style with a PS5 console cover in a range of colours, add extra storage, a removable disc drive*, vertical stand**, and a charging station for your controllers.

*This product is only for PS5 Digital Edition consoles (CFI-2000 model group – slim). Drive will play 4K Ultra HD Blu ray™ discs, Blu-ray discs, and DVDs. Internet connection required to pair Disc Drive and PS5 console upon setup. **Compatible Hardware: PS5® CFI-1000 model group, PS5® CFI-2000 model group - slim.
Screen image simulated
Feel the power of PlayStation in the palm of your hand as you play your PS5 console over your home Wi-Fi 4 with console-quality controls and a gorgeous 8-inch built-in display.

Bring your PS5 experience with you wherever you go with the companion PlayStation App. Stay in touch with PlayStation friends via text and voice chat, view your media gallery with Game Captures, purchase games via PlayStation™ Store, and more, all from the free app for Apple and Android devices.

raw_specs.section: Which PS5 console is right for you?

raw_specs.value: Choose how you play with a choice of Blu-ray Disc and all-digital consoles.
Play PS5 and PS4 games on Blu-ray discs. You can also download digital PS5 and PS4 games from PlayStation Store.

An all-digital version of the PS5 console with no disc drive. Download and play digital games from PlayStation Store, with an option to extend your play with an additional disc drive* (sold separately).

* This product is intended only for PS5 Digital Edition consoles (CFI-2000 and CFI 2100 model groups – slim). Drive will play 4K Ultra HD Blu ray™ discs, Blu-ray discs, and DVDs. Internet connection required to pair Disc Drive and PS5 console upon setup. For more details visit PlayStation.com/accessories .

raw_specs.section: It looks like you’re not a PS Plus member yet
raw_specs.raw_label: It looks like you’re not a PS Plus member yet
raw_specs.value: We don’t have any stats to show you. Join PlayStation Plus today - once you’re a member come back to see how your journey is progressing.
Sorry, it looks like we had a problem finding your data. Try refreshing, or come back later.
See what else your PS5 console can do.
Your favourite streaming services, together on PS5.
How we make play more accessible on PS5 consoles and in our games.
Controllers, gaming audio, additional storage and much more.
Yes. PS5 consoles are backwards compatible with PS4 games, with over 4000 titles ready to play. Find out more here: PS4 games playable on PS5 consoles.
PS5 consoles launched in select territories on 12 November 2020, with a full global launch soon after on 19 November 2020.
Yes, you can link your account for PlayStation and your Discord account to share your gaming activity, use voice chat and more. Get full details here: How to link your Discord account to PlayStation.

PS5 consoles are available in a range of digital and disc-based editions, as well as with different controller options and as software bundles. Check online retailers for availability and price details.

Players in the US, UK, Germany, Austria, France, Luxembourg, Belgium, Netherlands, Spain, Portugal and Italy can shop direct with PlayStation and enjoy additional benefits including free delivery on every order, from direct.playstation.com .
Visit PlayStation.com/support for assistance with a range of console, subscription and game issues.

The same features that make PS5 the best place to play have been packed into a smaller form factor, with a 1TB SSD for more internal storage. The new PS5 has been reduced in volume by more than 30%, and weight by 18% and 24% compared to the previous models.

1. Available when feature is supported by game. 3D audio via built-in TV speakers or analogue/USB stereo headphones. Set up required.

2. PlayStation Plus subscription fees recur until cancelled. Age restrictions apply. Full terms: www.playstation.com/legal/ps-plus-usage-terms . See playstation.com/ps-plus for details and updates on PS Plus offerings.

3. Upgrade may be offered at no additional cost or for a fee and may be available for a limited time. To upgrade eligible PS4 disc titles to digital PS5 versions, you need a PS5™ console with a disc drive. Streaming services may require paid subscription and may not be available in all countries. Internet and account for PlayStation required. Account holders must be 7+, under 18s require parental consent. Full terms apply: playstation.com/Terms.

4. PlayStation Portal remote player can stream compatible games installed on your PS5 console. PlayStation Portal remote player requires broadband internet Wi-Fi with at least 5Mbps for use. For a better play experience, a high-speed connection of at least 15Mbps is recommended. The quality and connectivity of your play experience may vary depending on your network environment. A PS5 console and account for PlayStation is required. The PS5 console must be connected to a broadband internet connection, powered on fully or in Rest Mode, and it must be paired with your PlayStation PlayStation Portal remote player.
5. A portion of the SSD is reserved for system software and other functions so the available SSD capacity may vary.
